authority_rule: Only official problem statements and primary research sources may authorize theorem_registry entries. Secondary sources may be used for discovery only.

sources.title: Existence and Smoothness of the Navier-Stokes Equation
sources.notes: Defines the official A-D formulations and includes errata for the periodic-pressure condition and a weak-form equation.

sources.title: Sur le mouvement d'un liquide visqueux emplissant l'espace
sources.notes: Classical foundation for global weak solutions in three dimensions; does not establish global smoothness or general uniqueness.

sources.title: On the Navier-Stokes initial value problem. I
sources.publisher_or_venue: Archive for Rational Mechanics and Analysis
sources.notes: Foundational local strong-solution framework; exact functional hypotheses must be taken from the source when reused.

sources.title: On the interior regularity of weak solutions of the Navier-Stokes equations
sources.publisher_or_venue: Archive for Rational Mechanics and Analysis
sources.notes: Source for Serrin-type conditional regularity; exact endpoint and domain hypotheses must not be weakened by summary.

sources.title: Partial regularity of suitable weak solutions of the Navier-Stokes equations
sources.publisher_or_venue: Communications on Pure and Applied Mathematics
sources.notes: Partial regularity for suitable weak solutions; does not imply that the singular set is empty.

sources.title: Strong Lp-solutions of the Navier-Stokes equation in Rm, with applications to weak solutions
sources.notes: Critical-space local theory and small-data global theory; not an arbitrary-large-data global result.

sources.title: On Leray's self-similar solutions of the Navier-Stokes equations
sources.notes: Excludes nontrivial classical backward self-similar profiles under the source's integrability hypotheses; not an exclusion of all possible blow-up mechanisms.

sources.title: On Leray's self-similar solutions of the Navier-Stokes equations satisfying local energy estimates
sources.publisher_or_venue: Archive for Rational Mechanics and Analysis
sources.notes: Extends self-similar exclusion under local-energy/integrability hypotheses. A published erratum exists in Arch. Rational Mech. Anal. 147 (1999), 363 and must be consulted before proof reuse.

sources.title: Well-posedness for the Navier-Stokes equations
sources.notes: Small-data global well-posedness in BMO^{-1}-type critical space; does not cover arbitrary large data.

sources.title: L_{3,infinity}-solutions of Navier-Stokes equations and backward uniqueness
sources.notes: The title notation L_{3,infinity} refers to the endpoint time-uniform spatial L3 context; do not silently reinterpret it as a spatial Lorentz L^{3,infinity} statement.
